$comment: THE ONE REGISTRY for the proposal system lab's knobs (the X-Bionic rework, 2026-10-10). Read by /test/proposal-system (TS import through lib/proposal-system/variants.ts) and by scripts/capture-proposal-system.mjs (readFileSync). TYPE IDS ARE LETTERS ONLY. THE FIRST VALUE OF EVERY KNOB IS PRODUCTION: PA is every knob at its first value and the control, byte-identical to /arcs/x-bionic/proposal; every other direction is one argument against it; PZ is the owner's whole brief at once. When the owner picks, the winning values land on the production record and the losing branches are deleted with their guards (ADR-070 U35).

order.label: Order
order.note: current = the page as shipped. narrative = the owner's order of 10 October: about, the vision, the approach, where it plugs in, Loop, two brands, X-Bionic.

interstitial.label: Chapter band
interstitial.note: chapter = ADR-153 U1's band: the ruler, an eyebrow, the line, a sentence and an index. quote = the ruler and the line alone.

jobHead.label: Job head
jobHead.note: strip = the four buckets with this one marked, a tall title, who/where/when as a block. mark = one lit discipline, the title one size down, one mono line, on the proof cards' gold band.

return.label: Loop's return
return.note: crew = ADR-133's circuit drawing. ledger = the same four rows as returns in the job's vocabulary: a value, a line, a tally.

approach.label: The approach
approach.note: handoff = ADR-153's three plates and two time bars. stack = one mono rail over the layer stack: the team on the organisation's slab, the layer appearing with its courses, Claude's runs along its edge.

upstream.label: Longer tasks
upstream.note: off = the approach beat carries the claim alone. horizon = a second beat on the owned horizon: the team's day upstream, the agent's run reaching up three times.

engine.label: The engine
engine.note: stack = ADR-154 U4's exploded stack, static. pinned = the same stack on a runway, its slabs and callouts lighting one after another as the reader scrolls.

directions.name: House
directions.question: the page as it ships: does it already read as one argument?

directions.name: Narrative
directions.question: in the owner's order, with the vision first and the layer placed after the approach, does the page read top to bottom?
directions.shape: the reordered sections, every beat as shipped

directions.name: Quote
directions.question: does a part open better on the line alone?
directions.shape: three chapter bands with no sentence and no index

directions.name: Mark
directions.question: with one lit discipline and the proof cards' gold band, do the jobs read as the Loop cards' kin?
directions.shape: four jobs on the mark head

directions.name: Ledger
directions.question: do Loop's returns and the jobs' returns read as one language?

directions.name: Stack
directions.question: does the layer being written, drawn once, say that adoption and automation are one motion?
directions.shape: the approach on the stack figure

directions.name: Horizon
directions.question: does the longer-horizon claim need its own beat, or does the stack's run carry it?
directions.shape: the stack, then the owned horizon

directions.name: Pinned
directions.question: read in nine lit steps on a pinned runway, does the engine stop being a diagram and become the object?

directions.name: The brief
directions.question: the owner's whole ask at once: one narrative, quote bands, marked jobs, one return language, the stack, the pinned engine.
directions.shape: every knob at its second value, the horizon off

wave.note: 1470x830 is the owner's MacBook Air, the binding cell (ADR-153); 1440x790 the smaller Air; 1920x1200 where the 880px fill cap engages. Every beat is one screen by content bottom.
